name: Grovy India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1985, Grovy India Ltd is in the business of construction and trading.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
GIL is a Real Estate and Infrastructure 
Development and Consultancy company.
 It has completed 100+ projects for over 500 
customers. The company has established itself 
as the creators of ‘Boutique Properties'

cons: Stock is trading at 2.67 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 7.31% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 6.97% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.40 Cr.
